messages:
Lina: Hey payroll team — corpcard soft-decline again yesterday in Tokyo. I had to pay a JPY 1,200 train fare out of pocket. Terminal printed a tiny receipt with merchant code 'TOK-TRN-742'. Card shows as authorized but declined at settlement. I attached a photo. What do I need to get reimbursed?

Maya (expensing): Sorry about that. For Japan we need the vendor receipt photo and the personal card statement showing the charge. Please file through the Expenses portal and pick category 'Travel - public transit'. Also add a short note 'corpcard settlement decline, paid personal'.

Lina: Filed as EXP-4091 and attached the receipt + bank screenshot. Also flagged for manager approval.

CFO (Raj): Approved for reimbursement. @Maya, please ensure FX conversion uses the rate on the transaction date and we apply small vendor policy.

expense-bot: New expense EXP-4091 submitted by Lina. Status: pending finance review.

Maya (expensing): Thanks. Quick note: small transit items under local equivalent of USD 50 don't need an itemized VAT invoice, photo + bank line is fine. Ill process EXP-4091 and open a ticket with the card vendor ops to investigate recurring soft-declines in APAC.

Lina: Appreciate it. Also looping in @DevOps-Bot because several of us working remotely in Japan hit declines — might be geographic fraud rules?

DevOps-Bot: Noted. Opening an incident: INC-2026-78 to track corpcard declines in JP region. Ops team will triage.

Lina: Great, thanks everyone. Will watch EXP-4091.

Maya (expensing): Processed EXP-4091, reimbursement queued. Expected payout in 5 business days.

Lina: Thanks!
